terms: As-generated, fixed price for 100% of metered output. Curtailment for economic reasons (negative real-time price) is paid as deemed generation at the contract price; curtailment instructed by the grid operator for congestion or reliability is not paid.

Scheduled maintenance, remote monitoring and fault response for all 12 turbines at a fixed annual fee. Corrective repairs are invoiced in addition: labour at 95 USD per hour and parts at list price, unless the component is under warranty. Guaranteed time-based availability of 97% per contract year (1 July to 30 June), averaged over the site. Forced outages and planned corrective work count as unavailable. Scheduled maintenance counts as available up to the allowance. Grid outages, curtailment, icing, high wind and force majeure such as lightning are excluded. Liquidated damages are paid on the energy lost below the guarantee, at the PPA price.

Five-year warranty on gearbox and main bearing from commissioning, extended to 31 December 2026. Covers parts, labour and crane for defects reported before the end date; requires oil analysis at least every six months.
Export capacity 50.4 MW at the Northwind Ridge 138 kV substation. The grid operator may limit output for congestion or reliability.
